name: Music Library
description: Browse your audio library by album and artist, with a built-in native-audio player and waveform. Catalog-backed: it reads the indexed audio assets (tagged by the base indexer) rather than an OS folder. Garnet's second plugin, compiled into the base binary; this manifest is a descriptive mirror of the frontend registration in apps/desktop/frontend/src/plugins/music/ and the native commands in apps/desktop/backend/src/music/.
